objective: Test whether each PIT-valid D22 transformation adds incremental Taiwan equity information beyond its primitive accounting, macro, event and overlapping credit dependencies, without treating the 22-domain curriculum as an AND-gate.

commonSupport.rule: Baseline and challenger are compared only on the exact same eligible issuer-date population. Coverage changes are reported separately and never converted into apparent alpha.
commonSupport.clusterRule: Multiple credit disclosures/events on the same issuer-date or one continuous deterioration/refinancing episode are clustered to prevent duplicate evidence weighting.
commonSupport.minimumEvidenceRule: Fewer than 20 mature independent paired dates remains ACCUMULATING and cannot support a directional conclusion; reaching 20 does not by itself satisfy L4.

outcomeFamily.rule: Do not search for the best horizon after outcomes are observed. D+40/D+60 are evaluated only after sufficient elapsed time.

moduleChallengers.failure: No incremental information or effect disappears after exact knownAt/common-support controls.
Coverage is only a repackaged profitability/leverage effect.
Structured liquidity/debt view adds no information beyond primitives.
Agency action is fully anticipated or duplicates existing deterioration.

moduleChallengers.transform: contractual liquidity/covenant trigger, cushion, breach/waiver state
moduleChallengers.failure: Only repeats the same ratio/cash information without contractual nonlinearity.
Fixed/floating label adds no incremental transmission information.
Funding-mix effect is only issuance-event or leverage repackaging.

validationSequence: Freeze eligible PIT source receipts and versions.
Freeze exact common-support population without return labels.
Freeze outcome horizons and event-clustering rules.
Open historical outcomes once for the frozen panel.
Run leave-one-date-out / walk-forward sensitivity with date clustering.
Hold out later independent dates or accumulate Prospective Shadow; never fabricate historical Shadow.
Report coverage, UNKNOWN rate, date/industry concentration, MFE, MAE, raw and adjusted returns together.
Apply multiple-testing accounting to every new threshold/window/classification.
Perform redundancy tests versus baselines and upstream D22 dependencies.
Only after OOS/prospective evidence may a module be considered for L4.
antiOverfit: No sign flipping after seeing outcomes.
No threshold optimization unless separately preregistered as a new experiment.
No changing maturity bucket, covenant definition, rating cluster or fixed/floating taxonomy after outcome opening.
No exclusion of losing industries/dates except pre-specified data-quality invalidations.
No duplicate votes from one underlying primitive or one deterioration/refinancing episode.

formalBoundary.promotionRule: L4 evidence is necessary but not sufficient for any Formal optimization. Cost, robustness, redundancy, multi-regime and owner approval remain required.
